services.desc: This unique program combines the ancient practice of Qigong with the healing power of sound, offering a transformative experience for both body and mind. Through a gentle series of Qigong movements, participants will learn to cultivate energy, enhance flexibility, and restore balance to their bodies. These mindful movements, rooted in Chinese traditions, are designed to promote the flow of Qi (life force energy) throughout the body, helping to release tension, reduce stress, and improve overall well-being.
